meta.name: customer-persona
meta.description: Research-backed customer persona creation with market data and avatar generation. Covers demographics, psychographics, jobs-to-be-done, journey mapping, and anti-personas. Use for: marketing strategy, product development, UX research, sales enablement, content strategy. Triggers: customer persona, buyer persona, user persona, target audience, ideal customer, customer profile, audience research, user research, icp, ideal customer profile, target market, customer avatar, audience persona

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建基于市场调研的客户画像，指导营销与产品策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用数据驱动的方式定义目标客户群体
copy.tagline_en: Create research-backed customer personas to guide marketing and product strategy
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to define target customer segments with data-driven insights

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据市场数据创建客户画像，包括人口统计、心理特征、目标、痛点、工作待办、购买流程和反画像，并生成头像图片。
howto.when: 当用户提到“客户画像”、“买家画像”、“目标受众”等关键词，或要求进行市场研究、产品开发、用户体验研究时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个SaaS产品经理的客户画像。
say.note: Claude 会按模板生成包含人口统计、心理特征等完整画像。

say.text: 生成一个34岁亚裔女性产品经理的头像。
say.note: Claude 会调用图像生成工具创建头像。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create data-backed customer personas including demographics, psychographics, goals, pain points, jobs-to-be-done, buying process, and anti-personas, and generate avatar images.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like "customer persona", "buyer persona", "target audience", or requests market research, product development, UX research.

say_en.text: Create a customer persona for a SaaS product manager.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a full persona with demographics, psychographics, etc.

say_en.text: Generate an avatar of a 34-year-old Asian female product manager.
say_en.note: Claude will call an image generation tool to create the avatar.
